elements.text: Stock Talk is an AI-powered financial analysis system designed to simplify stock market analysis through natural language interaction. The system allows users to query stock data in plain English, such as requesting historical price trends or comparing the performance of multiple companies, and automatically generates visual insights without requiring any technical or programming knowledge. It leverages Google’s Gemini 2.0 Flash Large Language Model to interpret user queries and dynamically generate Python code for stock data retrieval, analysis, and visualization using real-time data from Yahoo Finance. The backend is developed using Python with FastAPI and LangChain, while Redis is employed to maintain conversational memory, enabling context-aware follow-up queries. By eliminating the complexity of traditional stock analysis tools that rely on APIs and data visualization libraries, Stock Talk makes financial analysis more accessible to students, novice investors, and non-technical users. This project demonstrates the practical use of large language models in finance and highlights the effectiveness of conversational AI in transforming complex financial data into understandable visual representations.
